chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about what women do regarding the hair and the braids.
So he said: “This style of combing was not there; rather, they used to gather it.” Then he described four places, then he said: “They should be thorough in the washing.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةَ أَمْكِنَةٍ: four places or areas that were specified
key_terms.الْغَسْلِ: the ritual washing, here referring to ghusl
key_terms.الْقُرُونِ: the braids or plaited sections of hair
key_terms.الْمِشْطَةُ: a style of combing or arranging the hair

ai.seo_question: How should women wash their hair and braids during ghusl from janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a ruling related to women's hair arrangement during ghusl from janabah. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains that the hair used to be gathered and indicates that thorough washing must be carried out, including the relevant areas.
